services.name: Sunset River Tour
services.desc: Paddling down the Buffalo River, through the grain silo’s, is a great way to see a piece of Buffalo’s History and paddling back while watching a fabulous summer sunset… that is a magical experience. Our boats are easy to paddle and very stable, making them a great way to get started kayaking with minimal instruction. We use single and tandem kayaks daily from Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day Weekend. Guides accompany every tour on the river to help you maximize your river experience.
